It happened one Wednesday in a little café. It seemed a regular day with its hum drum, as always - coffee clatters, clanking cut silver. Yet something stirred within me that had lain still as dust since last summer, the same dust settling upon my computer’s desktop after an extended vacation abroad: an email, from work - the annual review, that had slipped from view.

At least that is why at that particular morning in this ordinary cafe it hit, a thought. The annual reviews. It is the season. As usual. And it would happen that this morning I sat there at that ordinary desk scribed out with coffee marks
